item.title: Cocoindex
item.description:
CocoIndex

Overview

CocoIndex is an ultra-performant real-time data transformation framework for AI with incremental processing. This skill enables building indexing flows that extract data from sources, apply transformations (chunking, embedding, LLM extraction), and export to targets (vector databases, graph databases, relational databases).

Core capabilities:

  1. Write indexing flows - Define ETL pipelines using Python
  2. Create custom functions - Build reusable transformation logic
  3. Operate flows - Run and manage flows using CLI or Python API

Redpanda Connect Component Search

Help users discover the right Redpanda Connect components for their streaming pipeline needs.

Objective

Find and recommend the most relevant components that match the user’s natural language query. Provide enough information for users to understand what each component does, how to configure it, and why it matches their needs.

Prerequisites

This skill requires: rpk, rpk connect, python3. See the SETUP for installation instructions.
